_about: RainReady network inputs for Klang South – Taman Sri Andalas, GENERATED by build_site.py on 22 Oct 2026 from open data. Screening only. Every value carries its status, source and confidence; most are assumed.

_status_key.measured: measured from the model (areas, land cover)
_status_key.planner input: a what-if set by the user

ari_years.source: MSMA 2nd Edition (DID Malaysia, 2012), Chapter 1 Design Acceptance Criteria, Table 1.1: link house / apartment, major system 100 yr; mixed developments take the highest ARI (Note 1)

lambda.source: MSMA 2nd Edition (DID Malaysia, 2012), Chapter 2, Table 2.B1 (Selangor), station 2913001

kappa.source: MSMA 2nd Edition (DID Malaysia, 2012), Chapter 2, Table 2.B1 (Selangor), station 2913001

theta.source: MSMA 2nd Edition (DID Malaysia, 2012), Chapter 2, Table 2.B1 (Selangor), station 2913001

eta.source: MSMA 2nd Edition (DID Malaysia, 2012), Chapter 2, Table 2.B1 (Selangor), station 2913001

station_choice.source: Nearest Table 2.B1 gauge to the site centre, 10.9 km away (JPS RF layer: Telemetri Telok Gong)

durations_h.source: MSMA 2.2.1: examine a range of storm durations; storm duration >= tc (MSMA 2.2.2). The critical one (most storage) is reported

design_duration_h.source: Empty: the design storm is today's critical duration. Set to one of durations_h to hold the storm fixed, e.g. so a blocked drain is compared with the clean drain under the same storm

tc_hours.source: As BBR (MSMA Table 2.1 overland + drain flow, ~23 min, rounded up); not worked out for this site

hydrograph_volume_factor.source: MSMA 2nd Edition (DID Malaysia, 2012), Chapter 2 Quantity Design Fundamentals, 2.3.2 Rational Hydrograph Method: Type 1 trapezoid and Type 2 triangle both hold Q x d

c_predevelopment.source: MSMA 2nd Edition (DID 2012), Chapter 2, Table 2.5 'Sport Fields, Park and Agriculture' (major system), as at BBR: the land before development is taken as agricultural or open land. Not checked for this site
c_predevelopment.note: Used for MSMA 1.2.1 peak discharge control: Qpost <= Qpre

band_change_medium_from.source: Team choice: a scenario needing 5 % more storage (or trunk demand) than today is 'medium'

band_change_high_from.source: Team choice: 20 % more than today is 'high'

band_capacity_medium_from.source: Team choice: storage required at 80 % of an entered stated capacity

band_capacity_high_from.source: At or above 100 % the entered capacity is exceeded
